sub_agendas_items.title: Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
During the Ottawa Board of Health meeting on January 13, 2025, Chair Catherine Kitts provided a verbal report that focused on a farewell message to the outgoing Medical Officer of Health, Dr. Vera Etches on behalf of the Board. 
The discussion on this item lasted approximately 5 minutes. The report was then received by the Board. The attached memo includes the Chair’s Verbal Update.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes: Dr. Vera Etches, the Ottawa Medical Officer of Health, delivered her farewell speech during the Board of Health Meeting on January 13, 2025. In her speech, she expressed gratitude for the opportunity to serve the community and highlighted the collaborative efforts that have significantly improved public health in Ottawa. Dr. Etches reflected on the challenges faced, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic, and praised the resilience and dedication of the public health team and the community. She also emphasized the importance of continuing to address health inequities and supporting mental health initiatives. Dr. Etches concluded by wishing her successor and the Board continued success in their efforts to promote and protect the health of Ottawa residents. The discussion on this item lasted approximately 20 minutes.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Selection of a Hiring Panel for the Recruitment of a Medical Officer of Health

attachments.attachment_title: Report - MOH Recruitment Selection Panel Appointment - 13Jan2025.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Board received an update from Chair Kitts regarding the selection of a hiring panel for the recruitment of a new Medical Officer of Health. The report recommended establishing a selection panel composed of the Chair, the Vice-Chair, Member Bauer and Member King. She advised that this panel will collaborate with the City of Ottawa’s Human Resources Department to secure the services of an external executive search firm, ensuring a thorough and effective recruitment process.
The discussion of the report lasted approximately 5 minutes long and emphasized the importance of a swift and efficient hiring process to fill the vacancy left by Dr. Vera Etches, who announced her resignation effective January 31, 2025.

sub_agendas_items.title: Appointment of an Interim Medical Officer of Health
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Member Carr made a motion to go into closed session at 5:30 pm. 
At 5:43 pm Member Carr made a motion to move out of closed session and resume in open session. Following the in-camera session, Chair Kitts welcomed everyone back and advised that the Board received information from City Staff regarding appointment of an Interim Medical Officer of Health. No motions were adopted during the closed session, with the exception of procedural motions and directions to staff.

motions.motion_text: BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit resolve In Camera pursuant to Section 13(1)(b) of the Procedure By-law 2011-1 to consider personal matters about an identifiable individual with respect to the appointment of an associate medical officer of health.

BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report, the Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report, and the reports titled: Confirmation of the Chair and Vice-Chair for 2025, Selection of a Hiring Panel for the Recruitment of a Medical Officer of Health and Appointment of an Interim Medical Officer of Health – In Camera – Personal Matters About an Identifiable Individual. Reporting Out Date: Not to be Reported Out, be received and adopted.
